notes: Sparsity or plausibility alone is not evidence for the declared topology (Appendix D, 'Connectome prior value').
Controls are agent C's; this gate refuses to synthesise them, because the control IS the experiment. A gate that invents its own null has measured nothing.

If the topology or any derived prior is route-fragile (agent C's ledgers carry route_agreement_r / route_fragile) or carries a forbidden_inference, that must be disclosed alongside the verdict: a topology claim inherits the fragility of the maps it was built from.

known_uninformative_fields.git_dirty_whole_tree: a whole-tree dirty flag always reads dirty during a run, because the run writes tracked output (reports/training/*.log, *.jsonl). It cannot distinguish modified source from a run writing its own log, so it is not recorded here and must not be gated on. Use source_dirty_paths.
